reference.question: Given \(\sqrt{3}\approx1.732\), calculate an approximate value of \(2\sqrt{3}-1\), rounding the result to the nearest \(0.01\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Substitute and round

\(2\sqrt{3}-1\approx2\times1.732-1=2.464\). Rounding to the nearest \(0.01\) gives \(2.46\).
